messages:
maria (sec-eng): Heads up 0min sync on Corvina prep. They asked for three things: explicit RBAC matrix, proof we can export tamper-evident audit bundles, and our KMS/HSM integration options for Private. Also they want our vuln triage cadence.

kevin (sales): They also want to know if we can map their existing AD groups -> roles and maintain SCIM sync. Want a yes/no + short notes.

arjun (infra): Yes. We support SAML group->role and SCIM provisioning. Note: group sync updates are eventual (few minutes). For Private we can configure SCIM endpoint in their IdP or run a proxy.

josh (platform): I'll draft a short example mapping: AD group: Corvina_Admin -> tenant_admin; Corvina_Devops -> tenant_operator; Corvina_Security -> tenant_auditor. Keep it explicit.

olivia (eng-oncall): On audit exports: we can deliver gzipped JSON bundles to their S3 with a signed manifest (signed by our key) plus a SHA256 chain file so they can verify ordering/tamper. Default: 90d on-host, can push to their archive daily.

maria (sec-eng): Add the option: if they require PKI attestation, we can provide signed manifests and a public verification key. Mention we do not provide customer-side HSM attestation by default; that would be part of HSM onboarding.

arjun (infra): HSM/KMS note: Private supports three patterns:
- Customer-managed cloud KMS (e.g., AWS KMS external keys)
- On-prem HSM bridged via KMIP or a customer gateway
- Redwood-managed KEK where root KEK is in our KMS but wrapped by customer key (bring-your-own-key hybrid)
Caveat: network firewall + routing + NTP/quorum checks required for HSM onboarding. Typical lead time 2-4 weeks.

kevin (sales): Corvina asked if we allow customer-held root keys (they call "full key custody"). What's the answer?

arjun (infra): We support BYOK for KEK wrap. Fully customer-held root keys with no operator access requires our Private-on-prem package and a separate legal contract. Short answer: possible, but needs SOW.

olivia (eng-oncall): IR timeline: for hosted customers we acknowledge Sev1 in 15m, initial customer notify in 60m. For Private we propose: acknowledge in 1h, initial notify within 4h (unless contract says otherwise). We can promise triage updates every 4h for criticals.

maria (sec-eng): Vulnerability triage policy for customer commits: initial risk classification within 72h, mitigation plan within 7d for high/critical, and weekly customer updates until resolved. We will not disclose exploit PoC without CRO approval.

josh (platform): Add a sample audit event snippet clients like to see:

```
{
  "timestamp": "2026-03-11T15:04:05Z",
  "tenant_id": "corvina-01",
  "actor": "svc-account-embed",
  "action": "kms:unwrap",
  "resource": "key/tenant/ke-01",
  "request_id": "req-7f8a9b",
  "outcome": "success",
  "diff": {"before": "ciphertext", "after": "decrypted-token"}
}
```

maria (sec-eng): For the tamper-evidence flow, add a 1-liner about hash chaining: we append each bundle's SHA256 to a chain file and sign the chain with our signing key. Customers can fetch the public key to verify.

kevin (sales): Any doc we can send ahead of the call? A one-page FAQ + a short 3-slide summary would be perfect.

josh (platform): I'll make the RBAC matrix + SCIM example and paste into the FAQ doc. Link when ready.

arjun (infra): I'll prepare the HSM onboarding checklist (network ports, certs, service accounts, maintenance windows).

security-bot: Created SEC-4921: Corvina deliverables. Owner: maria. Due: 2026-03-13.

maria (sec-eng): Perfect. Deadline for internal reviews EOD Wed. I'll assemble and ping for review in #eng-security. Thanks. :rocket:
